verdict.rationale: Appwrite is a backend-as-a-service platform, not an AI agent/orchestrator; the evidence shows Appwrite exposes its own MCP *server* so LLMs can call Appwrite's APIs (appwrite-docs-11, appwrite-probe-3, appwrite-probe-6) — the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether Appwrite itself can consume external MCP servers' tools. Being an MCP tool consumer is not a plausible capability for a backend platform of this kind, so this axis does not apply.
